facts.subject: Music festival
facts.statement: Organisers of a music festival on Tolan have added a second stage after tickets sold faster than expected.

source_ref.text_snippet: Organisers of a music festival on Tolan have added a second stage after tickets sold faster than expected.

facts.subject: Camping and shuttle buses
facts.statement: Camping is included in the ticket, and shuttle buses will run between the site and the town centre until midnight.

source_ref.text_snippet: Camping is included in the ticket, and shuttle buses will run between the site and the town centre until midnight.

facts.subject: Visitor guidelines
facts.statement: Organisers asked visitors to bring refillable water bottles and to leave glass containers at home.

source_ref.text_snippet: Organisers asked visitors to bring refillable water bottles and to leave glass containers at home.

facts.subject: Family area and campsite patrol
facts.statement: A quiet area has been set aside for families, and a team of volunteers will patrol the campsite overnight.

source_ref.text_snippet: A quiet area has been set aside for families, and a team of volunteers will patrol the campsite overnight.

flagged_facts.subject: Music festival duration
flagged_facts.statement: The festival will run for three days in a meadow outside the main town.
